cap_confirmation: driver state level_cap 100; offset-2 members L100, Mewtwo offset 3 L101 = cap+offset-2 on Medium.
chronology_note: Post-game after the Champion, pool-100 fully open; no gate-100 species (Mewtwo and the Steven's Cave paradoxes are reached at or after Leaf/Steven, later in play order). One reachable legend, Ting-Lu (DesertUnderpass sign gate 42); two Paradox wilds (Raging Bolt Route 119, Flutter Mane Mt. Pyre summit). The party was built specifically from the dossier's own crack: Electric attacks abuse their rain.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Kyogre Drizzle live on entry; Origin Pulse / Thunder in rain
Tornadus Tailwind when the speed race matters, else Bleakwind Storm (100% in rain)
Regenerator switch only when it improves the board
Zapdos Thunder / Hurricane at full accuracy in rain
Lugia Multiscale + Calm Mind win condition
Terapagos Terra form change on entry, Tri Attack
Mega Mewtwo X physical closer; Unnerve

attempts.why: t1 Fake Out flinched Tornadus (Sash chipped), Kyogre Ice Beam 213 on Rillaboom, rain-charged Electro Shot OHKO'd Kyogre (+1 SpA). t2 Rillaboom out for Ting-Lu (Vessel of Ruin), Bleakwind Storm resisted by Archaludon (Stamina +1), Hurricane confused Ting-Lu, Electro Shot left Zapdos at 34. t3 Electro Shot OHKO'd Tornadus; Ting-Lu hit itself. t4 Ting-Lu Protected Hurricane, Lugia Calm Mind, Electro Shot broke Multiscale (98). t5 Zapdos Protected at 2 HP, Lugia Calm Mind again, Electro Shot 184; rain and terrain expired. t6 Ting-Lu out for Incineroar (Intimidate), Zapdos Hurricane KO'd itself on Life Orb recoil, +5 Draco Meteor KO'd +2/+2 Lugia. t7 Mewtwo Mega Evolved and was Fake Out flinched, Terapagos Tri Attack 136 on Incineroar, +3 Draco Meteor OHKO'd Mega Mewtwo X (357). t8 Tri Attack KO'd Incineroar, +2 Def Body Press KO'd Terapagos. Faints: Incineroar. Raging Bolt, Flutter Mane never entered.

protect_ledger.payoff: read Rock Slide correctly, but Ting-Lu hit itself in confusion so nothing was blocked; partner Calm Mind. Effectively empty

protect_summary: 1 Protect, empty in effect (correct read). Kyogre, Tornadus, Lugia, Terapagos and Mewtwo never Protected.
ai_notes: No illegal choice. Weak spots: Tornadus never used Tailwind or its Regenerator switch; Lugia Calm Minded twice into a +3/+4 special attacker that had already broken Multiscale; Zapdos kept firing at 2 HP with a Life Orb and killed itself. None of these is a rules violation.
level_change_rationale: The fight is meant to be the hardest in the game and a tailored post-game party won it first try 6-1 in 7 turns with two reserves never used. Per the block instruction, +1 on the two weakest members (both 4 HP EV Sash/Life Orb bodies that were each OHKO'd by a single Electro Shot); Kyogre/Lugia/Terapagos/Mewtwo untouched. A level cannot close the real hole: an Electric attacker standing in their own rain (Archaludon Electro Shot, no charge, +1 per use) is super effective on four of the six and the roster carries no Ground type, no Lightning Rod / Volt Absorb and no weather-change answer.
cooler: The storm is spectacular but it is a glass storm: Kyogre died turn 1 to the exact crack the dossier names. To make it the hardest fight it needs a body that punishes the Electric answer - e.g. a Ground-type or Lightning Rod partner for Kyogre, or Tornadus leading Tailwind + Protect so the flyers move before the Electric attacker - and Lugia should attack rather than Calm Mind once Multiscale is gone. Species/set changes are outside this pass; reported only.
legality_notes: Sets legal; driver accepted the party. Terapagos's Terra form change and Mega Mewtwo X both executed natively.
verification_limit: Tornadus 2->3 and Zapdos 2->3 cannot be re-verified until the main agent rebuilds. This is the block's second-most-worth-rerunning battle; a rerun should use a non-Electric party to see whether the storm is hard for anyone who did not bring the dossier's answer.
